pages.text: Tier 1 Alchemy Altar: paper as main material, paper and a Jiao Whisker as ingredients. Requires Thunder Talisman knowledge.

Craft paper with a Jiao Whisker. Aim at a block within 32 blocks and use to call real lightning: consumes one, 5-second cooldown. Sprouting Antlers provide five crop bone-meal attempts; adult deer shed one every 20 minutes.
